title: Chapter 713
paragraphs: Chapter 713
Episode 180. Their Fight (3)
Anne lightly swung her twin swords, launching a sword aura. She intended to brush off the charging Tona brothers and aim straight for Mary.
However, the Tona brothers avoided Anne's sword aura and showed off their power by instantly demolishing one side of the fortress wall where Mu and Anne were standing.
Due to the destruction of the fortress wall, Mu and Anne had to leap to find a landing point and had to reconfirm Mary's location.
Mary was already rushing towards the inner fortress, but dust and debris momentarily obscured her.
[These bugs...!]
"Kyakyakya, did we slip away?"
"Did you think we would just fall in one blow?"
[Anne, take care of them. I will deal with Mary.]
As far as Mu was saying, she paused and looked forward.
Somehow, Daytona was pointing his greatsword at her.
"We are your opponents, Mu. Aren't you underestimating us too much? Well, I guess you wouldn't know how much effort we have put into catching you guys... It's understandable."

"Ah, you still don't understand the situation and are worried about Lady Mary. Hey, Anne. Wake up, you almost lost your neck just now. Huh? Oh, you mean it's okay to be cut off because you can just reattach it?"
A streak of chaos was flowing down Anne's neck like blood.
Heytona tried to lick the chaos stuck on his chain sword out of habit, but spat it out when he realized it was not blood.
Mu created a sword wind to clear the dust.
She couldn't see Mary.
She was extremely annoyed, but soon the sisters gave up on Mary and faced the Tona brothers.
Since Illina was in the inner fortress anyway, there was no need to pursue her aggressively.
However, they were furious that such a situation was created by the Tona brothers, who they usually dismissed as bugs.

[Mary would have been better off dying by our hands... she's still clueless. I've changed my mind, let's engage them. And spare them. You will live to witness the end of all those who rebelled against our mother.]
"Stop your yapping, eat this! It's the eleventh decisive battle of the family!"
'The eleventh?'
The decisive battles of Runkandel are a total of ten. Therefore, the Mu sisters thought for a moment that there was a decisive battle that they did not know.
In other words, they were taken by surprise. Meanwhile, the Tona brothers were already unfolding their own 'joint attack'.

- I've experienced countless swords, but this is the first time I've seen such a messy, disorderly, and lowly joint attack. Even the world's greatest swordsman, Runkandel, to show me this as a new decisive battle...
- Ah... Is it that primitive? Quite disappointing.
- It's literally garbage. Such a vulgar sword, unimaginable to the extreme.
- Is there no room for improvement at all?

- None... However, it's not a sword that should be discarded either. It's so chaotic that it can be effective at times. Unless you're an extraordinary master, you'll be flustered when you face something like this. It seems very effective against those with shallow depths. Hmm, have you named it?
- We've named it Tona Rampage.

- Tona Mess or Tona-style Free-for-all, a name like Brawl seems more appropriate... Rampage, huh. But since it's a decisive battle, the name has to be a bit modest. Use it only to confuse the opponent, then decide the outcome.

The reason why the Tona brothers shouted that their joint attack, 'Tona Rampage', was the eleventh secret of the family, was because they received such advice from Hedo right after they completed the technique.
'This thing... the eleventh decisive battle of the family?'
That's impossible.
As soon as the Rampage started, the faces of the Mu sisters distorted.
The Tona brothers were already tearing up the surroundings, true to the name of Rampage.
When the greatsword split the ground, the chain sword tore through it, and the brothers' chaos didn't stop for a moment.
The problem was that their countless attacks were not reaching the Mu sisters at all.
The Mu sisters brushed off the occasional flying stones and sneered.
"The next one is the 3rd decisive battle, Meteor Shower!"
"The 5th secret technique, Lightspeed Stab!"

Then the Tona brothers added nonsense during the Rampage, making the sisters flinch a few times, and eventually, they gathered their energy to press down with strength. There was nothing better than this when dealing with such a rootless sword.
But the Tona brothers, as if they had anticipated all of this, unfolded the real decisive battle just when the Mu sisters had gathered their energy.
Flash and Falling Flowers, the 4th and 6th decisive battles of Runkandel. Daytona unfolded Falling Flowers and Heytona unfolded Flash, bursting out from within the Rampage.
Screak! Screech!
The swords of the brothers and sisters intertwined, and shock waves spread out.
The Tona brothers were pushed back more, but they were already flipping the insides of the Mu sisters by spreading the Rampage again.
"Kkekkekke."
"Fell for it again!"
Mu and Anne fulfilled all the conditions mentioned by Hedo.
They were experiencing this ridiculous decisive battle for the first time, and while they had grown stronger due to their spirit, they lacked depth as martial artists.
[Wow, it's a real bug-like technique.]
Anne chuckled, but it was clear that the sisters were not effectively dealing with Tona's Rampage.
The 'one shot' the Tona brothers mentioned to Mary was effectively pressuring the sisters.
However, there was a fatal drawback to the Rampage.
It consumes a tremendous amount of stamina.
The Tona brothers could only keep up their flurry of attacks for barely 10 minutes in their current state.
In that time, they either had to win or receive support from their allies to survive.
After that time, they wouldn't have the energy left to even run away.
As the fight between the Tona brothers and Mu sisters continued, new enemies appeared on the battlefield still raging behind them, in the open field of Licalton Castle.
"Joosan, are you okay!" Lutan shouted. The former execution knight of Run Kandel, he was currently leading the youngest division to rescue the prisoners.
The giant fist of the beast was constantly throwing debris at Lutan and the youngest division as it tore up the ground.
Thanks to Hedo, they were hardly ever directly attacked, but occasionally dangerous moments came.
"I'm fine!"
"Stick with Scott and rest for a while, you can't continue the operation if you're this exhausted. Mesa, you're in charge of Joosan's area for a while."
"Yes, Sir Lutan!"
The open field was full of massive cracks created by the beasts.
Lutan caught a berry about to fall into a crack, only to discover that it led to an underground tunnel.
'This is what Jin Kyung talked about...!'
Just as Lutan realized, a streak of sword energy sprang from the ground, brushing his cheek as it passed.
As Lutan retreated and swung his sword, the youngest division's gaze gathered.
From the tunnel emerged knights in black robes.
Lutan recognized their outfits as the old-fashioned black sword society robes from when he was an execution knight.
[Lutan... you really were alive.]
"Vex, it was you. Then next to you must be Rain, Rihanna, and Sinatra."
[It's an honor to have you remember our names, former Execution Knight Lutan Perman.]
-Black Sword Society, subdue Joshua Run Kandel.
-Yes, Sir!
-Rain, Vex, Rihanna... Sinatra too. You guys... were all... members of the Black Sword Society...!
Vex, Rain, Rihanna, Sinatra.
They were knights who had subdued Joshua when Rosa caused him to fall, as members of the Black Sword Society.
Before joining the Black Sword Society, they had also served as execution knights like Lutan, working together on missions.

"I heard from Jin Kyung that you guys are still playing the role of Rosa's dogs. But I didn't know you were still there even after the family has come to this point. If you had any pride, you would have chosen to fight and die with the resistance when Rosa fell. But here you are."

[A hunting dog that was thrown away and luckily picked up by the 12th generation is quite talkative. How about it, would you swear allegiance to our lord again now? Then you could be an execution knight of Run Kandel again.]

"Clear out and come on. My dead comrades are waiting for you in the afterlife... Youngest division! You should retreat immediately and move to a different area, retreat as far as you can, where Sir Hedo is if possible!"
There were four Knights of Chaos in front of Lutan.
Although their numbers were fewer than Lutan's, they were already beyond what the youngest division could handle.
Lutan was trying to buy time for the youngest division to run away somehow.
But already, three in black robes were emerging from the cracks on the youngest division's side.
[Long time no see, Jin Run Kandel's bastards.]
[You haven't forgotten our voices, have you?]
"Kazin Romero, Hass brothers...!?"
Kazin Romero, Mile Hass, and Lima Hass.

They were disciples of the middle-level class, part of Mu and Ann's factions. They were those who had been abandoned by Mu and Ann on a middle-level mission with Jin, and were expelled from the family.
When the three of them were expelled, none of the middle-level disciples felt sorry. It was because of the misdeeds they had done by piggybacking on Mu and Ann during their middle-level days.

-Now I might seem ridiculous. But you guys will soon be in the same position as me. We're different from the purebloods. No matter how hard we try, we're just pets they raise, and in the end, this is what happens...... Ha, take care.
Words Kazin Romero had said when he left the disciples' hall.
"Wow, I didn't expect to run into those bastards here."
"Looks like they struggled to crawl back into the rotten Garden of Swords after being abandoned by Mu and Ann's faction? Well, the Garden of Swords is just the stage for trash like you now."
The youngest division reformed their ranks and glared at Kazin's group.
But Mesa decided that Lutan's orders were a priority.
"Bellop, Scott and I will stay and deal with them. The rest of you retreat and notify the situation in the rear, otherwise, we can't save Sir Lutan."
The fight between those who defile Run Kandel, and those who seek to reclaim Run Kandel.
The former was overwhelmingly in a better position.
The youngest division retreated under Mesa's command, and the ones who remained spread out to prevent the enemies from chasing them.
In such a way, new battles were opening up all over the battlefield.

Most were fights between Jin and Defus, Mary and the Prophet, the Tona brothers and the Mu sisters, the youngest division and the Knights of Chaos, representing Run Kandel and the corrupted Run Kandel.
However, on the opposite side of the youngest division, a confrontation was beginning between the empire's former special forces and the current special forces.
"Crap!"
Alisa screamed as she was flung away, hit by something.
"Alisa Vetsor, 2nd Unit of the former special forces, and rebel against the imperial court. I will execute you in the name of the great Bimunt Empire."
Codename Rats, former leader of the 3rd Unit of Bimunt's special forces.
Suddenly mixed in the battlefield, he was pointing his sword at Alisa, who had fallen.
